```{r helpers, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Remove the trailing "_<batch>" suffix appended to sample IDs
strip_batch <- function(x) sub("(.*)_[^_]*$", "\\1", x)

# "a) X, b) Y, and c) Z" style list, used for narrative captions
letter_and_list <- function(x) {
  out <- paste0(letters[seq_along(x)], ") ", x)
  if (length(out) > 1) out[length(out)] <- paste("and", out[length(out)])
  out
}

# Color a PASSED / WARNING / FAILED status value for kable/LaTeX output
color_status <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "PASSED"  ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#006b54", color = "white"),
    x == "WARNING" ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#ffd858"),
    x == "FAILED"  ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#D2042D", color = "white"),
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# Wrap flagged cells in a red LaTeX colorbox.
# status_cols is a named vector: names are the columns in `status_df` that
# hold "FAILED"/"PASSED", values are the matching column to highlight in
# `value_df`. Matching is by row position, mirroring how the original
# per-row loops worked.
highlight_failed <- function(value_df, status_df, status_cols) {
  for (status_col in names(status_cols)) {
    val_col <- status_cols[[status_col]]
    rows <- which(status_df[[status_col]] == "FAILED")
    for (i in rows) {
      value_df[i, val_col] <- paste0(
        "\\colorbox{myred}{\\textcolor{white}{\\textbf{", value_df[i, val_col], "}}}"
      )
    }
  }
  value_df
}

# Standard PASSED/WARNING/FAILED legend used on the QC tables
pass_fail_legend <- c(
  "\\\\colorbox{mygreen}{\\\\textcolor{white}{PASSED}}", "  |  ",
  "\\\\colorbox{myyellow}{WARNING}", "  |  ",
  "\\\\colorbox{myred}{\\\\textcolor{white}{FAILED}}"
)

# Render a QC table: switches to a repeating longtable once it's too long
# for one page (>= longtable_threshold rows), otherwise scales to fit.
render_qc_table <- function(df, legend, italic_col = 3, longtable_threshold = 30) {
  long <- nrow(df) >= longtable_threshold
  df %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "c",
          row.names = FALSE, longtable = long) %>%
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = if (long) c("repeat_header", "scale_down") else c("scale_down", "hold_position"),
      font_size = if (long) 7 else NULL
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, background = "#D4D4D4", bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(italic_col, italic = TRUE) %>%
    footnote(general = legend, general_title = "Legend:", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, escape = FALSE)
}
```

```{r load-data, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- rename species column to wgs_id and fill in genus-only IDs ---
wgs_df <- wgs_result_df %>%
  rename(wgs_id = species) %>%
  mutate(wgs_id = case_when(
    wgs_id == "Acinetobacter" ~ "Acinetobacter baumannii",
    wgs_id == "Escherichia"   ~ "Escherichia coli",
    TRUE ~ wgs_id
  ))

# --- load organism code reference file ---
org_df <- read_xlsx(here("data_files/", "whonet_codes_2024.xlsx"), "ORGANISM") %>%
  select(ORG_ARS, ORGANISM_name) %>%
  rename(wgs_id = ORGANISM_name, org_code = ORG_ARS)

# --- merge & clean organism code ---
wgs_df <- wgs_df %>%
  left_join(org_df, by = "wgs_id") %>%
  mutate(
    org_code_clean = case_when(
      wgs_id %in% c("Escherichia/Shigella", "Escherichia coli/Shigella") ~ "eco",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Salmonella enterica") ~ "sat",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Salmonella") ~ "sal",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus pseudopneumoniae") ~ "spn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus pyogenes") ~ "spy",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus oralis") ~ "sol",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus") ~ "spn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Staphylococcus epidermidis") ~ "sep",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Staphylococcus") ~ "sau",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Shigella") ~ "shi",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Vibrio") ~ "vic",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Klebsiella") ~ "kpn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Raoultella planticola") ~ "kpn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Pseudomonas") ~ "pae",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Acinetobacter") ~ "aba",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Burkholderia") ~ "pce",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Serratia marcescens") ~ "sma",
      TRUE ~ org_code
    )
  )
```

```{r sample-sheet, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- Read samplesheet ---
wgs_samplesheet <- read_csv(here(paste0("data_files/", get_samplesheet, ".csv")))

# --- Get experiment name ---
WGS_exp_name <- unique(wgs_samplesheet$experiment_name)

# --- remove special characters in batch name ---
batch_name_clean <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", batch_code)

# --- Modify dataframe ---
wgs_samplesheet <- wgs_samplesheet %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_replace_all(toupper(sample_id), "-", "_"),
    sample_id = paste(sample_id, batch_name_clean, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, description, index_plate_well)
```

```{r wgs-data, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- Subset wgs_df ---
wgs_id_df <- wgs_df %>% select(sample_id, wgs_id)

# --- paste batch number to arsrl result sample_id ---
arsrl_id_df <- arsrl_result_df %>%
  mutate(sample_id = paste(sample_id, batch_name_clean, sep = "_"),
    iso_num = row_number())

# --- merge arsrl result and samplesheet ---
arsrl_result_merge <- unique(arsrl_id_df) %>%
  left_join(unique(wgs_samplesheet), by = "sample_id")

# --- Merge WGS and ARSRL results, restore original WGS sample order ---
qc_listing_df <- unique(wgs_id_df) %>%
  left_join(unique(arsrl_result_merge), by = "sample_id")

qc_listing_df <- qc_listing_df[match(wgs_result_df$sample_id, qc_listing_df$sample_id), ]
qc_listing_df$wgs_id[is.na(qc_listing_df$wgs_id)] <- "Not Identified"

# --- Handle samples with no WGS results ---
wgs_no_result <- wgs_samplesheet[!wgs_samplesheet$sample_id %in% wgs_df$sample_id, ]


if (nrow(wgs_no_result) > 0) {
  qc_listing_df$description <- ifelse(
    is.na(qc_listing_df$description),
    wgs_id_df$description[match(
      paste0(wgs_no_result$sample_id, "_", batch_name_clean),
      wgs_id_df$sample_id
    )],
    qc_listing_df$description
  )
}

# --- Concordance check and assign isolate number---
qc_listing_df <- qc_listing_df %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = word(arsrl_org, 1),
    concordant = case_when(
      arsrl_org == "No Referred Data" ~ TRUE,
      wgs_id == "Not Identified"      ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ str_detect(wgs_id, Genus),
    ),
    arsrl_org = if_else(concordant, arsrl_org, paste0(arsrl_org, " (x)"))
  )

# Match concordance back to WGS df
wgs_df$concordant <- qc_listing_df$concordant[match(wgs_df$sample_id, qc_listing_df$sample_id)]

```


```{r sunburst-graph, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align='center'}
# --- Modify and Filter Bactscout dataframe ---
df_bactscout_mod <- df_bactscout %>%
  mutate(name = gsub("-", "_", name)) %>%
  filter(name %in% sample_name)  %>%
  mutate(species = str_remove(species, ";.*"))


final_result_df <- df_bactscout_mod %>%
  select(species, a_final_status) %>%
  mutate(species = if_else(is.na(species), "Unidentified", species))


sunburst_df <- final_result_df %>%
  count(species, a_final_status, name = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    label = a_final_status,
    parent = species
  )

# Add species as root nodes
species_df <- sunburst_df %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    label = species,
    parent = ""
  )

sunburst_data <- bind_rows(
  species_df %>% select(label, parent, value),
  sunburst_df %>% select(label, parent, value)
)


sunburst_data <- sunburst_data %>%
  mutate(
    bold_label = paste0("<b>", label, "</b>"),
    ids = ifelse(parent == "", label, paste(parent, "-", label)),
    color = case_when(
      label == "PASSED"  ~ "#006b54",
      label == "FAILED"  ~ "#D2042D",
      label == "WARNING" ~ "#ffd858",
      TRUE               ~ "#aec7e8" # Default for bacteria
    )
  )


# 3. Create the plot
fig <- plotly::plot_ly(
  data = sunburst_data,
  ids = ~ids,
  labels = ~bold_label,
  parents = ~parent,
  values = ~value,
  type = 'sunburst',
  branchvalues = 'total',
  marker = list(colors = ~color),
  insidetextfont = list(size = 15),
  outsidetextfont = list(size = 15),
  hovertemplate = "<b>%{label}</b><br>Value: %{value}<extra></extra>"
)

fig <- fig %>% plotly::layout(
  title = list(
    font = list(size = 10),
    y = 0.05,
    x = 0.5,
    xanchor = 'center',
    yanchor = 'bottom'
  ),
  margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 40) 
)


fig <- fig %>% plotly::layout(
  margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 40)
)

fig

```

```{r qc-listing, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- Identify failed WGS sample names ---

failure_color <- which(qc_listing_df$sample_id %in% raw_read_failed)

# --- Clean up ---
qc_listing_df <- qc_listing_df %>%
  select(-Genus, -concordant) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = strip_batch(sample_id))

# Rename and reorder columns
colnames(qc_listing_df) <- c("Sample ID", "WGS", "ARSRL", "Isolate No.", "Description", "Index")
qc_listing_df <- qc_listing_df[, c("Isolate No.", "Sample ID", "Description", "Index", "ARSRL", "WGS")]

# --- Generate formatted table ---
# --- Generate Legend HTML ---
qc_legend <- HTML(paste0(
  "<strong>Legend: </strong>",
  "PASS | ",
```

```{r low-reads, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
# --- filter dataframe based on the sample_id not present in the WGS samplesheet ---
wgs_lowreads <- wgs_samplesheet[!(wgs_samplesheet$sample_id %in% wgs_df$sample_id), ] %>%
  select(sample_id, description)

if (nrow(wgs_lowreads) != 0) {
  lowreads_table <- wgs_lowreads
  lowreads_table$remarks <- "low read count"
  
  # Remove batch name in sample_id
  lowreads_table$sample_id <- sub("(.*)_[^_]*$", "\\1", lowreads_table$sample_id)
  colnames(lowreads_table) <- c('Sample ID', 'Description', 'Remarks') 

  # --- Create Custom Header for "add_header_above" equivalent ---
  # This creates a spanning header row across all 3 columns
  sketch <- htmltools::withTags(table(
    class = 'display',
    thead(
      tr(
        th(colspan = 3, style = "border-bottom: 1px solid #111;", "Sample excluded in the analysis")
      ),
      tr(
        lapply(colnames(lowreads_table), th, style = "text-align: center;")
      )
    )
  ))

  # --- Render Interactive Table ---
  lowreads_print <- datatable(lowreads_table,
            container = sketch,        # Uses the custom header defined above
            rownames = FALSE,
            class = 'cell-border stripe',
            options = list(
              dom = 'Bfrtip',               # Only show the table (no search/pagination) as it's a summary
              scrollX = TRUE,
              columnDefs = list(
                list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"), # Center all body cells
                list(width = '150px', targets = 0),              # Approx 3cm
                list(width = '150px', targets = 1),              # Approx 3cm
                list(width = '350px', targets = 2)               # Approx 7cm
              ),
              initComplete = JS(
                "function(settings, json) {",
                "$(this.api().table().header()).find('tr:eq(1) th').css({",
                "  'background-color': '#D4D4D4',",
                "  'color': 'black',",
                "  'text-align': 'center'", # Centers the header text block
                "});",
                "}"
                )
              )
  )
  
  # Render the table
  lowreads_print
}
```

***Table 2.*** **Summary of raw reads quality control analysis.**
```{r bactscout-df-value, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Identify Samples Without Bactscout Results
no_bactscout_result <- setdiff(sample_name, df_bactscout_mod$name) %>% 
  str_remove("_[^_]*$")

# 2. Define metric status columns mapping: "Display Column" = "Status Column in df_bactscout_mod"
status_cols <- c(
  "Species Abundance"     = "contamination_message",
  "Coverage (Qualibact)" = "coverage_estimate_qualibact_status",
  "Duplication Rate"      = "duplication_status",
  "GC Content"            = "gc_content_status",
  "MLST (ST)"             = "mlst_status",
  "Read Length"           = "read_length_status",
  "Read Q30"              = "read_q30_status"
)

# Clean and Prepare Main Display Data Frame
bactscout_df_merge <- df_bactscout_mod %>%
  # Normalize contamination message to PASSED / FAILED first
  mutate(contamination_message = ifelse(contamination_message == "OK", "PASSED", "FAILED")) %>%
  # Merge with Isolate ID mapping
  inner_join(arsrl_id_df, by = c("name" = "sample_id")) %>%
  transmute(
    `Isolate No.`          = iso_num,
    `Sample ID`            = str_remove(name, "_[^_]*$"),
    Species                = str_remove(species, ";.*"),
    `Species Abundance`    = str_remove(species_abundance, ";.*"),
    `Coverage (Qualibact)` = coverage_estimate_qualibact,
    `Duplication Rate`     = duplication_rate,
    `GC Content`           = sprintf("%.1f", gc_content),
    `MLST (ST)`            = ifelse(is.null(mlst_st) | is.na(mlst_st), "", as.character(mlst_st)),
    `Read Length`          = paste0(read1_mean_length, " - ", read2_mean_length),
    `Read Q30`             = read_q30_rate,
    `Final Status`         = a_final_status,
    
    # Explicitly create hidden status helper columns with safe fixed names
    status_contamination_message            = contamination_message,
    status_coverage_estimate_qualibact_status = coverage_estimate_qualibact_status,
    status_duplication_status                 = duplication_status,
    status_gc_content_status                  = gc_content_status,
    status_mlst_status                        = mlst_status,
    status_read_length_status                 = read_length_status,
    status_read_q30_status                    = read_q30_status
  )

# Define Legend & Table Options
legend_html <- HTML(paste0(
  "<strong>Legend: </strong>",
  '<span style="background-color: #006b54; color: white; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">PASSED</span> | ',
  '<span style="background-color: #ffd858; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">WARNING</span> | ',
  '<span style="background-color: #D2042D; color: white; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">FAILED</span>'
))

# Number of visible display columns
disp_cols <- 1:11

# Build DT Interactive Table
bactscout_table <- datatable(
  bactscout_df_merge,
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  escape = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'cell-border stripe',
  caption = tags$caption(style = 'caption-side: bottom; text-align: left;', legend_html),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    dom = 'lBfrtip',
    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'print'),
    # Hide helper status columns (columns 12 onwards)
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = 11:(ncol(bactscout_df_merge) - 1), visible = FALSE)),
    initComplete = JS(
      "function(settings, json) {",
      "  $(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color': '#D4D4D4', 'color': 'black'});",
      "  $(this.api().table().header()).find('th').css('text-align', 'center');",
      "}"
    )
  )
) %>%
  # Target Final Status styling
  formatStyle(
    'Final Status',
    target = 'cell',
    backgroundColor = styleEqual(c('PASSED', 'WARNING', 'FAILED'), c('#006b54', '#ffd858', '#D2042D')),
    color = styleEqual(c('PASSED', 'WARNING', 'FAILED'), c('white', 'black', 'white')),
    fontWeight = 'bold'
  ) %>%
  formatStyle(disp_cols, textAlign = 'center') %>%
  formatStyle('Species', fontStyle = 'italic')

# 6. Apply dynamic cell red highlighting based on hidden status columns
for (disp_col in names(status_cols)) {
  status_col_name <- paste0("status_", status_cols[[disp_col]])
  bactscout_table <- bactscout_table %>%
    formatStyle(
      disp_col,
      valueColumns = status_col_name,
      backgroundColor = styleEqual('FAILED', '#D2042D'),
      color = styleEqual('FAILED', 'white'),
      fontWeight = styleEqual('FAILED', 'bold')
    )
}

bactscout_table

```

```{r recommendation-table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Gather all QC failure sources safely
failures_list <- list(
  # Non-concordant WGS
  wgs_df %>%
    filter(concordant == "FALSE" | concordant == FALSE) %>%
    transmute(sample_id, failed_conditions = "Non-concordant result"),

  # Failed raw reads (from BactScout)
  bactscout_df_result %>%
    filter(!is.na(failed_cols) & failed_cols != "") %>%
    transmute(sample_id = name, failed_conditions = failed_cols)
)

# Add low read count failures if present
if (exists("wgs_lowreads") && nrow(wgs_lowreads) > 0) {
  failures_list[[length(failures_list) + 1]] <- wgs_lowreads %>%
    transmute(sample_id, failed_conditions = "Low read counts")
}

# Combine and aggregate failures by Sample ID, then group by failure reasons
summary_raw_df <- bind_rows(failures_list) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, "_[^_]*$")) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    failed_conditions = paste(unique(failed_conditions), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Handle Empty State vs Aggregated State
if (nrow(summary_raw_df) == 0) {
  summary_raw_df <- tibble(
    `Sample ID` = "-",
    `Reason - Failed Metrics` = "No further action required for this batch."
  )
} else {
  summary_raw_df <- summary_raw_df %>%
    group_by(failed_conditions) %>%
    summarise(
      sample_id = paste(unique(sample_id), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      `Sample ID` = sample_id,
      `Reason - Failed Metrics` = failed_conditions
    )
}

# Create Custom Header Sketch
sketch <- htmltools::withTags(table(
  class = 'display',
  thead(
    tr(
      th(colspan = 2, 
         style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; color: black; text-align: center;", 
         "Summary of Raw Reads with FAILED QC results")
    ),
    tr(
```

### **ASSEMBLY QC**

$\\$

***Table 3.*** **Summary of assembly reads quality control analysis.**
```{r assembly-qc, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- Data Preparation & Cleaning ---
assembly_qc <- merge(wgs_df, arsrl_id_df, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    wgs_id_clean = case_when(
      wgs_id %in% c("Escherichia/Shigella", "Escherichia coli/Shigella") ~ "Escherichia coli",
      TRUE ~ wgs_id
    )
  )

# --- Qualibact Reference Processing ---
qualibact_data <- read_csv(here("data_files/","qualibact_filtered_metrics_07292026.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    species = str_replace_all(species, "_", " "),
    metric_clean = str_to_lower(metric)
  )

# Determine genus-only species present in sample
genus_ids <- assembly_qc %>%
  filter(!str_detect(wgs_id, " ")) %>%
  pull(wgs_id) %>%
  unique()

# Generate reference ranges for exact species matches
qualibact_ref <- qualibact_data %>%
  filter(species %in% assembly_qc$wgs_id_clean)

# Aggregate genus-level bounds if genus-only IDs exist
if (length(genus_ids) > 0) {
  wgs_pattern <- paste(genus_ids, collapse = "|")
  
  genus_ref <- qualibact_data %>%
    filter(str_detect(species, wgs_pattern)) %>%
    mutate(species = str_extract(species, "^[^ ]+")) %>%
    group_by(species, metric_clean) %>%
    summarize(
      lower_bounds = min(lower_bounds, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper_bounds = max(upper_bounds, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  qualibact_ref <- bind_rows(qualibact_ref, genus_ref) %>%
    mutate(across(c(lower_bounds, upper_bounds), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.), NA, .)))
}

# --- Metric Mapping & QC Checks ---
metric_map <- c(
  "completeness"           = "completeness",
  "contamination"          = "contamination",
  "total_coding_sequences" = "total_coding_sequences",
  "genome_size"            = "genome_size",
  "gc_content"             = "gc_content",
  "n50"                    = "n50_contig_length",
  "no_of_contigs"          = "total_contig"
)

assembly_qc_checked <- assembly_qc

# Loop to append threshold joins and run bound check evaluations
for (m in names(metric_map)) {
  ref <- qualibact_ref %>%
    filter(metric_clean == m) %>%
    select(species, lower_bounds, upper_bounds)
  
  col_name <- metric_map[m]
  qc_col <- paste0(col_name, "_qc")
  
  assembly_qc_checked <- assembly_qc_checked %>%
    left_join(ref, by = c("wgs_id_clean" = "species")) %>%
    mutate(
      !!qc_col := case_when(
        !is.na(lower_bounds) & .data[[col_name]] < lower_bounds ~ "FAILED",
        !is.na(upper_bounds) & .data[[col_name]] > upper_bounds ~ "FAILED",
        TRUE ~ "PASSED"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-lower_bounds, -upper_bounds)
}

# --- Summarize QC Failure Reasons & Merge Extra Metadata ---
qc_cols <- c(
  "Completeness"            = "completeness_qc",
  "Contamination"           = "contamination_qc",
  "Total Coding Sequences"  = "total_coding_sequences_qc",
  "Genome Size"             = "genome_size_qc",
  "GC Content"              = "gc_content_qc",
  "N50"                     = "n50_contig_length_qc",
  "Total Contigs"           = "total_contig_qc"
)

assembly_qc_checked <- assembly_qc_checked %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    failed_conditions = {
      values <- c_across(all_of(unname(qc_cols)))
      failed <- names(qc_cols)[values != "PASSED"]
      if (length(failed) == 0 || all(is.na(failed))) NA_character_ else paste(failed, collapse = ", ")
    },
    assembly_result = if_else(is.na(failed_conditions), "PASSED", "FAILED")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    select(bactscout_df_result, name, raw_reads_result = a_final_status),
    by = c("sample_id" = "name")
  )

# --- Export ---
write_xlsx(assembly_qc_checked, "data_files/assembly_qc_checked.xlsx")
```

```{r aasembly-qc-graph, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Create a conversion function to convert Basepairs to MEgabasepairs
bp_to_mb <- function(bp) {
  x <- bp / 1e6
  x <- format(round(x, 2), nsmall = 2)
  x <- paste0(x, " Mb")
  return(x)
}

assembly_qc_value$genome_size <- bp_to_mb(assembly_qc_value$genome_size)


# Rename and reorder columns
colnames(assembly_qc_value) <- c("Isolate No.","Sample ID", "WGS ID", "Completeness", "Contamination", "Total Coding Sequences",
                                 "Genome Size", "GC Content", "N50", "Total Contig", "Raw Reads Result", "Assembly Result")
```

```{r amr_genes ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
wgs_species <- wgs_df %>% select(sample_id, wgs_id)

df_amrfinderplus1 <- df_amrfinderplus
names(df_amrfinderplus1) <- tolower(names(df_amrfinderplus1))
names(df_amrfinderplus1)[names(df_amrfinderplus1) == 'name'] <- 'sample_id'
names(df_amrfinderplus1)[names(df_amrfinderplus1) == 'element symbol'] <- 'element_symbol'

df_amrfinderplus1 <- df_amrfinderplus1 %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub("-", "_", sample_id, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  inner_join(wgs_species, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(wgs_id = gsub("quasi", "", wgs_id, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(grepl(batch_name_clean, sample_id)) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = strip_batch(sample_id))

amr_genes_species <- unique(df_amrfinderplus1$wgs_id)
amr_genes_list <- letter_and_list(amr_genes_species)

# One summary table per species, keyed by species name (replaces the
# original assign()/get()-by-string-name pattern with a plain named list).
amr_gene_tables <- list()

for (sp in amr_genes_species) {
  sample_ids <- df_amrfinderplus1$sample_id[df_amrfinderplus1$wgs_id == sp]

  amr_genes_df <- df_amrfinderplus1 %>%
    mutate(
      subclass = gsub("NA", "", subclass, fixed = TRUE),
      Newcols = gsub("/", "/ ", paste(type, subclass), fixed = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    select(sample_id, Newcols, element_symbol) %>%
    group_by(Newcols, sample_id) %>%
    summarize(Concat = paste0(element_symbol, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Newcols, values_from = Concat)

  amr_gene_tables[[sp]] <- amr_genes_df[amr_genes_df$sample_id %in% sample_ids, ]
}
```

```{r amr_gene_tables, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Create a list to store all table outputs
amr_outputs <- list()

for (idx in seq_along(amr_gene_tables)) {
  df_orig <- amr_gene_tables[[idx]]

  # Work on a copy of wgs_species to avoid modifying the original in each iteration
  wgs_species_1 <- wgs_species

  names(df)[names(df) == 'wgs_id'] <- 'species'
  names(df)[names(df) == 'sample_id'] <- 'Sample ID'
  
  df <- df %>% relocate(species, .after = `Sample ID`)
  df <- df[, colSums(is.na(df)) < nrow(df)]
  
  # Get unique species value for the header
  species_val <- unique(df$species)[1]
  species_val <- paste0(letters[idx], ") ", species_val)
  
  # Subset to remove species column as it goes in the 'sketch' header
  df_subset <- subset(df, select = -c(species))
  
  # --- Create Custom Header ---
  sketch <- htmltools::withTags(table(
    class = 'display',
    thead(
      tr(
        th(colspan = ncol(df_subset), 
           style = "font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #111; text-align: left;", 
           species_val)
      ),
      tr(
        lapply(colnames(df_subset), th, style = "text-align: center;")
      )
    )
  ))

  # --- Create the interactive table ---
  tbl <- datatable(df_subset,
    container = sketch,
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = 'cell-border stripe',

      dom = 'lBfrtip',
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'print'),

      ),
      initComplete = JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$(this.api().table().header()).find('tr:eq(1) th').css({",
        "  'background-color': '#D4D4D4',",
        "  'color': 'black',", # Added missing comma
        "  'text-align': 'center'", # Added centering
        "});",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
  
  # 2. Store the table and spacing in the list
  # We use tags$div with style to replace \vspace
  amr_outputs[[idx]] <- tagList(
    tbl,
    tags$div(style = "margin-bottom: 30px;") 
  )
}
```
